title: PortSwigger Web Security Academy — JWT authentication bypass via unverified signature (alg=none)

expected_chain.rationale: log in as wiener:peter and capture the session JWT
decode the JWT, modify sub claim to 'administrator', re-encode with alg=none, replay against /admin

notes: PortSwigger JWT lab #1 — the canonical alg=none bypass. The lab session needs cookies, so the solver path involves curl -c/-b cookie-jar. Equivalent to TryHackMe's JWT room task 4.
